heroBody: The Samsung Galaxy S25 and Apple iPhone 17 are the two flagship phones most US buyers cross-shop in 2026. The Galaxy S25 brings Samsung's Snapdragon 8 Elite processor, a 6.2-inch AMOLED display and a triple camera system with a 50MP main sensor. The iPhone 17 runs Apple's A19 chip, a 6.1-inch OLED with ProMotion and a 48MP main camera with a new 2x telephoto. This page pulls live US listings from BuyWhere's catalog so you can see the current floor price for each, who is offering it, and whether the cheapest listing is a carrier deal, unlocked or refurbished.

highlightSectionTitle: Key differences that matter in daily use

highlights.title: Camera and photo quality
highlights.body: The Galaxy S25's 3x optical telephoto gives it more reach for portraits and distant shots, while the iPhone 17's new 2x telephoto is better for everyday framing. Both take excellent photos in daylight; Samsung's night mode is slightly brighter, Apple's skin tones are more natural. If you shoot a lot of video, the iPhone 17's ProRes and Action mode are hard to beat.

highlights.title: Performance and software
highlights.body: The Snapdragon 8 Elite trades blows with the A19 in benchmarks, but real-world speed is indistinguishable. The bigger difference is software: Samsung's One UI 7 offers more customization (split-screen, DeX desktop mode, sideloading), while iOS 19 is simpler and gets app updates first. If you use a Mac or iPad, the iPhone ecosystem integration is a strong reason to stay.

highlights.title: Battery life and charging
highlights.body: The Galaxy S25's 4,000 mAh battery lasts a full day with moderate use; the iPhone 17's 3,800 mAh is close but drains faster on 5G. Samsung charges at 25W wired (0-50% in 30 min), Apple at 30W wired (0-50% in 25 min). Both support wireless charging; Samsung adds reverse wireless charging for earbuds.

adviceSectionTitle: How to choose between the Galaxy S25 and iPhone 17
advicePoints: If you already own an Apple Watch, AirPods or Mac, the iPhone 17 is the obvious choice — ecosystem lock-in is real and switching costs are high.
If you want the most camera flexibility (3x telephoto, 50MP sensor, manual controls), the Galaxy S25 edges ahead.
Carrier deals often make one phone significantly cheaper than the other — check this page for the current floor price before deciding.
Both phones start at the same unlocked price, but trade-in values differ: Apple typically offers more for older iPhones, Samsung offers more for older Galaxies.
If you plan to keep the phone 4+ years, Samsung's 7-year update promise is longer than Apple's typical 5-6 year support window.
Consider the Galaxy S25 if you want USB-C with full DisplayPort alt mode (external monitor support) — the iPhone 17 still limits USB-C to charging and data.
faqSectionTitle: Galaxy S25 vs iPhone 17 — common questions

faqs.question: Is the Galaxy S25 or iPhone 17 better for photography in 2026?
faqs.answer: Both are excellent. The Galaxy S25 has a 3x telephoto and 50MP sensor for more detail and reach; the iPhone 17 has better video (ProRes, Action mode) and more natural skin tones. For social media photos, either is more than enough.

faqs.question: Which phone lasts longer on a single charge — Galaxy S25 or iPhone 17?
faqs.answer: The Galaxy S25's 4,000 mAh battery gives it a slight edge in screen-on time (8-9 hours vs 7-8 hours for the iPhone 17). Both last a full day with moderate use; heavy 5G or gaming drains either by evening.

faqs.question: Can I switch from iPhone to Galaxy S25 easily?
faqs.answer: Samsung's Smart Switch app transfers contacts, photos, messages and most app data from an iPhone. The main friction is losing iMessage, FaceTime and Apple ecosystem features; most Google and third-party apps work identically on both.

faqs.question: Is the Galaxy S25 or iPhone 17 cheaper in the US right now?
faqs.answer: Both start at the same unlocked price, but carrier deals, trade-in offers and seasonal sales make one cheaper than the other at any given time. This page shows the current live floor price for both so you can compare.

faqs.question: Which phone gets software updates longer?
faqs.answer: Samsung promises 7 years of OS and security updates for the Galaxy S25; Apple typically supports iPhones for 5-6 years. In practice, both phones will be current through 2030-2031.

categoryIntro.heading: Why this comparison matters in 2026
categoryIntro.body: The Galaxy S25 and iPhone 17 are the two phones most US buyers consider when upgrading from a 2-3 year old device. Both have flagship cameras and both will be supported for years. The real differences are in ecosystem (Android vs iOS), camera reach (3x vs 2x telephoto) and software flexibility (Samsung's customization vs Apple's simplicity).
